note: A component with no loading/disabled/error state declares an empty `states` list rather than implementing fake behaviour — the contract is honest, not aspirational.

components.name: SvButton
components.purpose: The canonical action control. Performs an action; never navigates.
components.keyboard: Native button: Enter and Space activate. Disabled and loading are non-interactive.
components.responsive: Optional block variant for the mobile primary action; 44px target at every size.
components.theme: Four token-backed variants; visible focus in both themes via .sv-focus-ring.

components.name: SvIconButton
components.purpose: An icon-only control whose accessible name is a required prop.
components.keyboard: Native button. Reflects aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-pressed when supplied.
components.responsive: not_applicable — fixed 44x44 minimum at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Three token-backed variants; visible focus in both themes.

components.name: SvLink
components.purpose: Navigation. Internal RouterLink or external anchor with a safe new-tab contract.
components.keyboard: Native anchor. A disabled link renders a span, so it leaves the tab order entirely.
components.responsive: not_applicable — inline element.
components.theme: Link and hover colours are semantic tokens in both themes.

components.name: SvLogo
components.purpose: The approved Logo.png wordmark at three sizes, with explicit dimensions.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — an image.
components.responsive: Three fixed sizes chosen by the caller; aspect ratio preserved.
components.theme: The approved bitmap is never recoloured or filtered in either theme.

components.name: SvPageHeader
components.purpose: The single page-title region. Owns the page h1.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — a layout region; its slotted controls carry their own contracts.
components.responsive: Actions stack full width on mobile and sit inline from tablet up.
components.theme: Heading and muted description use semantic tokens.

components.name: SvBreadcrumbs
components.purpose: Ancestor navigation as a named nav landmark containing an ordered list.
components.keyboard: Native links; the current page is text with aria-current="page".
components.responsive: The middle of a long trail is hidden below tablet but stays in the DOM.
components.theme: Link and separator colours are semantic tokens.

components.name: SvCard
components.purpose: A grouped content surface. Deliberately not clickable.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — a container; it never captures activation from its contents.
components.responsive: Four padding steps chosen by the caller.
components.theme: Raised surface and border are semantic tokens.

components.name: SvMetricCard
components.purpose: A headline figure with optional trend. Computes nothing.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — presentation only.
components.responsive: Fills its grid cell.
components.theme: Trend tones are semantic status tokens; direction is also stated in text.

components.name: SvStatusBadge
components.purpose: A status indicator whose label is always rendered as text.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — presentation only.
components.responsive: Two sizes.
components.theme: Five token-backed tones, contrast-checked in both themes.

components.name: SvMoney
components.purpose: Integer-minor-unit money. Unavailable is never rendered as zero.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — presentation only.
components.responsive: Three sizes; tabular numerals so columns align.
components.theme: Muted unavailable state and signed negative use semantic tokens.

components.name: SvDateTime
components.purpose: A timestamp or business date in Africa/Nairobi, never the browser timezone.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — presentation only.
components.responsive: not_applicable — inline element.
components.theme: Muted unavailable state uses a semantic token.

components.name: SvAlert
components.purpose: An inline message attached to the content it concerns.
components.keyboard: The dismiss control is a named icon button.
components.responsive: Stacks its action row on narrow widths.
components.theme: Four severities, each a token triple, contrast-checked in both themes.

components.name: SvBanner
components.purpose: A page- or account-level notice. A named region, not a live region.
components.keyboard: The dismiss control names the banner it dismisses.
components.responsive: Wraps its action row on narrow widths.
components.theme: Three severities from semantic tokens.

components.name: SvToast
components.purpose: Transient, globally positioned confirmations from the notification store.
components.keyboard: Each toast carries a named dismiss control.
components.responsive: Anchored above the fixed footer at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Four token-backed types.

components.name: SvSkeleton
components.purpose: A decorative loading placeholder that never looks like data.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — hidden from assistive technology.
components.responsive: Fills the box the real content will occupy.
components.theme: Subtle surface token; animation suppressed under reduced motion.

components.name: SvEmptyState
components.purpose: There is genuinely nothing here yet.
components.keyboard: The optional action is a native button.
components.responsive: Centred column at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Warm surface and muted text tokens.

components.name: SvErrorState
components.purpose: The request failed. Retry is offered only when repeating is safe.
components.keyboard: The retry control is a native button.
components.responsive: Centred column at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Error tokens, contrast-checked in both themes.

components.name: SvOfflineState
components.purpose: The browser has no connection. A different remedy from a server error.
components.keyboard: The retry control is a native button.
components.responsive: Centred column at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Muted surface tokens.

components.name: SvPermissionState
components.purpose: You may not view this. Never names the resource or confirms it exists.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — no control; a correct refusal has no retry.
components.responsive: Centred column at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Neutral tokens — a refusal is not an error.

components.name: SvLockedState
components.purpose: This exists and you may see it, but a business rule has closed it to changes.
components.keyboard: Slotted actions carry their own contracts.
components.responsive: Centred column at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Warning tokens.

components.name: SvDialog
components.purpose: The canonical modal dialog, built on the one shared focus trap.
components.keyboard: Focus enters on open and is trapped; Escape closes unless persistent; focus returns to the trigger.
components.responsive: Height-capped and internally scrolling, so it fits at 360px and at 200% zoom.
components.theme: Scrim and raised surface are semantic tokens.

components.name: SvConfirmDialog
components.purpose: Confirm before an irreversible action. Focuses Cancel when destructive.
components.keyboard: Inherits SvDialog; initial focus is Cancel for a destructive action.
components.responsive: Inherits SvDialog.
components.theme: Destructive variant uses error tokens.

components.name: SvDrawer
components.purpose: An off-canvas panel sharing the one focus trap.
components.keyboard: Focus enters on open and is trapped; Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger.
components.responsive: Typed placement; `responsive` is a bottom sheet on mobile and a side panel from tablet up, by CSS only.
components.theme: Scrim and raised surface are semantic tokens.

components.name: SvPopover
components.purpose: Anchored, non-modal content. Never hover-only.
components.keyboard: Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; outside click closes.
components.responsive: Width-capped to the viewport, so it cannot push the page sideways.
components.theme: Raised surface and border tokens.

components.name: SvMenu
components.purpose: An ACTION menu implementing the WAI-ARIA menu-button pattern.
components.keyboard: Down/Up open and cycle, Home/End jump, Escape closes, disabled items are skipped.
components.responsive: Width-capped to the viewport.
components.theme: Destructive items use error tokens.

components.name: SvTabs
components.purpose: The WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with roving tabindex.
components.keyboard: Arrow keys move focus; activation is automatic or manual by typed prop.
components.responsive: The tablist wraps rather than scrolling.
components.theme: Active tab uses the brand token.

components.name: SvAccordion
components.purpose: A disclosure group whose headers are headings containing buttons.
components.keyboard: Native buttons; aria-expanded and aria-controls are wired both ways.
components.responsive: Full width at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Border and surface tokens.

components.name: SvTooltip
components.purpose: Supplementary hint text. Never the only accessible name.
components.keyboard: Shows on focus, dismissible with Escape without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13).
components.responsive: Width-capped; never contains interactive content.
components.theme: Raised surface with a ring token.

components.name: SvFormField
components.purpose: The single owner of label, help, error and described-by association.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — it wraps a control rather than being one.
components.responsive: Full width; the message row is always reserved so fields do not jump.
components.theme: Four status tones from semantic tokens.

components.name: SvTextInput
components.purpose: A single-line text control over a native input.
components.keyboard: Native input.
components.responsive: Full width with a 44px minimum height.
components.theme: Input border and disabled tokens.

components.name: SvTextArea
components.purpose: A multi-line text control with a counter that appears only near the limit.
components.keyboard: Native textarea.
components.responsive: Full width.
components.theme: Input border and disabled tokens.

components.name: SvSelect
components.purpose: A native select with option groups. The default choice over a custom listbox.
components.keyboard: Native select — the platform picker on mobile.
components.responsive: Full width with a 44px minimum height.
components.theme: Input border and disabled tokens.

components.name: SvCombobox
components.purpose: A filterable single-select for a long or server-loaded list.
components.keyboard: Full combobox pattern with aria-activedescendant; Escape closes and keeps focus.
components.responsive: Listbox is height- and width-capped.
components.theme: Selected option uses the selected-state tokens.

components.name: SvCheckbox
components.purpose: A native checkbox. Deliberately not a switch.
components.keyboard: Native checkbox; indeterminate is set as a DOM property.
components.responsive: Full width row.
components.theme: Brand accent and input border tokens.

components.name: SvRadioGroup
components.purpose: A single choice in a fieldset with a legend, so the GROUP is named.
components.keyboard: Native radios — the browser supplies roving arrow-key navigation.
components.responsive: Stacks on mobile; optional inline layout from tablet up.
components.theme: Brand accent and input border tokens.

components.name: SvDatePicker
components.purpose: A business-date field over the native date input. No date library added.
components.keyboard: Native date input — platform keyboard and picker support.
components.responsive: Full width; the platform supplies the mobile picker.
components.theme: Input border and disabled tokens.

components.name: SvMoneyInput
components.purpose: An amount field emitting integer minor units. Empty is null, never zero.
components.keyboard: Native input with decimal inputmode; tidies to two decimals on blur only.
components.responsive: Full width with a currency affix.
components.theme: Subtle affix surface and input border tokens.

components.name: SvPhoneInput
components.purpose: A phone field that previews the canonical form without rewriting the entry.
components.keyboard: Native tel input.
components.responsive: Full width.
components.theme: Muted preview line uses a semantic token.

components.name: SvFileUpload
components.purpose: The Phase 10F file-selection foundation. No direct provider integration.
components.keyboard: Native file input with a labelled trigger.
components.responsive: Full width.
components.theme: Status text uses semantic status tokens.

components.name: SvSearchInput
components.purpose: A native search field with a named clear control. Issues no requests.
components.keyboard: Native search input; clearing returns focus to the field.
components.responsive: Full width.
components.theme: Input border and muted icon tokens.

components.name: SvFilterBar
components.purpose: The filter region above a list. Holds no business or query knowledge.
components.keyboard: The mobile disclosure is a native button with aria-expanded.
components.responsive: Collapses behind a disclosure on mobile; always visible from tablet up.
components.theme: Brand count badge and input border tokens.

components.name: SvDataTable
components.purpose: The desktop/tablet semantic table, driven by the shared column contract.
components.keyboard: Sort headers are native buttons; an opt-in scroll region is keyboard scrollable.
components.responsive: Renders from tablet up; SvResponsiveRecordList renders on mobile.
components.theme: Header, row hover and border tokens.

components.name: SvResponsiveRecordList
components.purpose: The mobile labelled record cards, from the SAME column contract. Loses nothing.
components.keyboard: The per-card detail disclosure is a native button with aria-expanded.
components.responsive: The mobile counterpart of SvDataTable; never scrolls horizontally.
components.theme: Raised surface and border tokens.

components.name: SvPagination
components.purpose: Page navigation reporting only what the server supplied.
components.keyboard: Named previous/next icon buttons, disabled at the boundaries.
components.responsive: Compact label on mobile, spelled out from tablet up.
components.theme: Subtle control tokens.

components.name: SvTimeline
components.purpose: An ordered event sequence that implies no causality beyond the source data.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — presentation only.
components.responsive: Single column at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Brand marker and border tokens; status carried by SvStatusBadge.

components.name: SvAuditEvent
components.purpose: One audit row. Read-only by construction; masking stays server-side.
components.keyboard: The metadata disclosure is a native details/summary.
components.responsive: Single column at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Raised surface and muted label tokens.

components.name: SvProfileControl
components.purpose: The identity unit in the shell header, hosting the account switch and logout.
components.keyboard: Opens on click, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.
components.responsive: Avatar-only on mobile with a full screen-reader name; text from tablet up.
components.theme: Warm avatar surface and raised menu tokens.

components.name: SvAccountContextSwitcher
components.purpose: The final presentation of UI-03’s account switch. Holds no security logic.
components.keyboard: Native buttons; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
components.responsive: Menu or inline variant; width-capped to the viewport.
components.theme: Selected-state tokens mark the current context.

components.name: SvNotificationsControl
components.purpose: The notifications visual contract. Data-driven; no notification API exists yet.
components.keyboard: Named icon-button trigger; Escape closes and returns focus.
components.responsive: Panel is height- and width-capped.
components.theme: Error badge and raised panel tokens.

components.name: SvThemeToggle
components.purpose: The one theme control. Writes to the user record when signed in.
components.keyboard: Native button/switch with an accessible name describing the action.
components.responsive: Icon variant in the footer; labelled switch variant in preferences.
components.theme: It IS the theme control; both variants are token-backed.

components.name: SvFixedFooter
components.purpose: The viewport-fixed footer whose height token also drives the page reserve.
components.keyboard: All links are native anchors, last in the document order.
components.responsive: Three height tokens plus a zoom fallback; stacks on mobile.
components.theme: Footer surface, text and border tokens, contrast-checked in both themes.

components.name: SvLandingSection
components.purpose: A landing section shell named by its own heading. Contains no copy.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — a layout region.
components.responsive: Stacks on mobile; content and media sit side by side from desktop.
components.theme: Three surface tones from semantic tokens.

components.name: SvLegalDocument
components.purpose: Renders an approved legal document verbatim through the escaping markdown renderer.
components.keyboard: not_applicable — a document.
components.responsive: Constrained to a readable measure.
components.theme: Prose colours from semantic tokens.

components.name: SvFaq
components.purpose: An accessible FAQ disclosure over native details/summary. Fabricates nothing.
components.keyboard: Native details/summary — keyboard and state support from the platform.
components.responsive: Full width at every breakpoint.
components.theme: Raised surface and border tokens.
